units.source: {#1/}Some events added to the wiki after 2020 and at least few earlier-added Noble Houses Civil War crisis events have or may contain erroneous information regarding the settlement type and size. For example, in Civil War Ambush and alike events the settlement type must be {#2}non{/#2}-military and of size {#3}less{/#3} than the stated one ({#4}for reference{/#4}: the code line containing the settlement type data in the game files for these events is followed by the "continue;" line).{#5/}{#6/}
units.zh: {#1/}2020 年之后加入本 Wiki 的部分事件，以及至少一部分更早收录的贵族内战危机事件，可能或确实存在聚落类型、规模方面的信息错误。例如，在“内战伏击”及类似事件中，聚落必须是{#2}非{/#2}军事聚落，且规模应{#3}小于{/#3}页面写出的数值。{#4}可参考{/#4}游戏文件中的代码：这些事件里，包含聚落类型判断的那一行后面紧接着“continue;”。{#5/}{#6/}

provenance.method: Independent whole-unit manual English/Chinese review of Wiki conditions, outcomes and explanations.

units.source: It is possible that some other events may contain this type of errors (and, possibly, other inaccuracies) too. Some of those may be due to the code changes introduced in the DLCs and patches, while others - due to code misinterpretations. So, generally, all events need to be re-checked for conformity with the code of the latest official game version. Additionally, some other useful information, e.g. the terrain types requirement for the event proc'ing, can be added or specified as well.{#1/}
units.zh: 其他事件也可能存在这类错误，甚至还有别的不准确之处。有些源于 DLC 和补丁对代码的修改，有些则源于对代码的误读。因此，原则上应按最新正式版游戏的代码重新核对所有事件。此外，还可以补充或明确其他有用信息，例如触发事件所要求的地形类型。{#1/}

provenance.method: Independent whole-unit manual English/Chinese review of Wiki conditions, outcomes and explanations.

units.source: Note that even in the latest game version there may be certain in-game bugs which can cause events to have unintended and unexpected behavior. Edits to these events pages must contain proof of the bug existence, backed up by a link to the official game support forum thread with the answer provided by a forum moderator or the devs or marked by either of them as the answer to the issue stated in the thread. In all other, standard, cases the events pages content must be based on the game code.
units.zh: 请注意，即使在最新版本中，游戏本身也可能存在程序错误，导致事件出现非预期的行为。修改这些事件页面时，必须提供错误确实存在的证据，并附上游戏官方支持论坛的讨论链接；该讨论应有版主或开发者作出的答复，或有被他们标记为解决该问题的答复。其他通常情况下，事件页面的内容应以游戏代码为依据。

units.source: The roll is 3-18 inclusive, implying three six-sided dice are rolled. The correct distribution for this roll has a bell-shaped curve, where middle rolls are more frequent than extremes. The game instead uses the uniform distribution, which has the equal probability for every value. This affects the probability of the draw: it is 6.25% in the game, while the correct one is around 9.28%.
units.zh: 掷出的总点数为 3-18，包含两端，意味着掷了三枚六面骰。实际掷这种骰子的点数分布应呈钟形，中间点数比两端点数更常见。游戏却使用均匀分布，让每个点数出现的概率相同。这会影响平局概率：游戏中为 6.25%，而按真正的掷骰分布计算，应约为 9.28%。

provenance.method: Independent whole-unit manual English/Chinese review of Wiki conditions, outcomes and explanations.

units.source: You are send to stop a group of deserters. You can choose:
units.zh: 你受命拦下一群逃兵。你可以选择：

units.source: "Is this who you want to be? Cowards that won't defend their own lands?"
units.zh: “你们就想当这样的人？连自己的家园都不敢保卫的懦夫？”

provenance.method: Independent whole-unit manual English/Chinese review of Wiki conditions, outcomes and explanations.

units.zh: “选择很简单：为领主而战，或者死在这里。”

units.source: "Let's be honest what this is about. Here's {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} if you return."
units.zh: “咱们把话挑明了吧。只要你们回去，这些{#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1}就是你们的。”

provenance.method: Independent whole-unit manual English/Chinese review of Wiki conditions, outcomes and explanations.

units.source: Your cargo is an evil artifact and starts moving. You can choose:
units.zh: 你运送的货物是一件邪恶器物，此时竟动了起来。你可以选择：

units.source: There is a 50% chance to gain the {#1}Cursed Crystal Skull{/#1} from this fight and you can choose:
units.zh: 这场战斗有 50% 概率掉落{#1}诅咒水晶骷髅{/#1}，随后你可以选择：

units.source: "We're paid to deliver this, so that's what we'll do."
units.zh: “收了钱送货，就得把货送到。”

units.source: You can continue the contract as if nothing had happened

units.source: You get to keep the {#1}Cursed Crystal Skull{/#1} no matter what you choose to do with the evil artifact
units.zh: 无论如何处置那件邪恶器物，你都可以保留{#1}诅咒水晶骷髅{/#1}。

units.source: You can gain the {#1}Cursed Crystal Skull{/#1} only once per campaign
units.zh: 每次战役只能获得一次{#1}诅咒水晶骷髅{/#1}。

provenance.method: Independent whole-unit manual English/Chinese review of Wiki conditions, outcomes and explanations.

units.source: After obtaining the stolen property, you are offered a higher reward for the object by a shady man. Accepting the offer will result in the failure of the contract.

units.source: You meet graverobbers. They offer a map that leads to a site rich in treasures if you let them go free. You can choose:
units.zh: 你遇到一群盗墓贼。他们愿意用一张通往宝藏的地图换取自由。你可以选择：

units.zh: “好吧，把地图交出来，就让你们活着离开。”

provenance.method: Independent whole-unit manual English/Chinese review of Wiki conditions, outcomes and explanations.

units.source: You get an undead location revealed, 1 extra {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}silver bowl{/#4} and {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} {#8}silver ware{/#8} can be looted there.

provenance.method: Independent whole-unit manual English/Chinese review of Wiki conditions, outcomes and explanations.

units.zh: 50% 概率：因委托完成得不够好，你只获得 1/2 的报酬。

units.source: Mercenaries demand the cargo you are delivering. You can choose:

units.source: "It's not worth dying over. Take that damn cargo and be gone."
units.zh: “不值得为这送命。拿上那该死的货物，滚吧。”

provenance.method: Independent whole-unit manual English/Chinese review of Wiki conditions, outcomes and explanations.

units.zh: 从这场战斗中撤退也会导致委托失败。

units.zh: 另一支佣兵团拦住了你，要求交出你正在运送的首领头颅。你可以交出头颅，让委托失败；也可以与他们战斗，保住头颅。

provenance.method: Independent whole-unit manual English/Chinese review of Wiki conditions, outcomes and explanations.

units.source: After killing all the {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}webknechts{/#4} you discover a {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} {#8}retired soldier{/#8}. He offers to join you. He will always have the {#9}{#10}{#11/}{/#10}{/#9} {#12}fear of beasts{/#12} or {#13}{#14}{#15/}{/#14}{/#13} {#16}hate for beasts{/#16} trait.

provenance.method: Independent whole-unit manual English/Chinese review of Wiki conditions, outcomes and explanations.

units.source: The {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}lindwurms{/#4} are attacking a caravan. If less than 5 caravans are destroyed you get an extra reward. You get 3 extra caravan hands for the fight. The reward is that an undead location is revealed that will contain a named item.
units.zh: {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1}{#4}林德蠕龙{/#4}正在袭击商队。被摧毁的商队货车少于 5 辆时，你可获得额外奖励。战斗中会额外有 3 名商队杂工协助你。奖励是在地图上揭示一处藏有名贵装备的亡灵据点。

provenance.method: Independent whole-unit manual English/Chinese review of Wiki conditions, outcomes and explanations.

units.source: You notice a cage with a prisoner with your cargo who wants to be freed. You can choose:
units.zh: 你发现运送的货物中有一个关着囚犯的笼子，囚犯请求你放他出来。你可以选择：

provenance.method: Independent whole-unit manual English/Chinese review of Wiki conditions, outcomes and explanations.

units.source: "Don't waste your breath. I don't give a shite who you are."
units.zh: “省省口水吧。我才不在乎你是谁。”

provenance.method: Independent whole-unit manual English/Chinese review of Wiki conditions, outcomes and explanations.

units.source: "This better be worth it. I'll hold you to your promises once I've freed you." (you lose a large amount of reputation)
units.zh: “最好值得我冒险。放你出来后，我会要你兑现承诺。”你会失去大量声誉。

provenance.method: Independent whole-unit manual English/Chinese review of Wiki conditions, outcomes and explanations.

units.source: 67% chance: You gain 3000 {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} and a reputation boost with their house.

provenance.method: Independent whole-unit manual English/Chinese review of Wiki conditions, outcomes and explanations.

units.source: You find that someone else took the relic before you arrived. Catch up to them and get the artifact back. You can choose:
units.zh: 你发现有人抢先一步拿走了遗物。追上他们，将遗物取回。你可以选择：

provenance.method: Independent whole-unit manual English/Chinese review of Wiki conditions, outcomes and explanations.

units.source: "You made a terrible mistake, challenging the company. Your last one."
units.zh: “敢跟我们战团作对，是你犯下的大错，也是最后一个错。”

provenance.method: Independent whole-unit manual English/Chinese review of Wiki conditions, outcomes and explanations.

units.source: You will fight a {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Brigand Leader{/#4} and a band of {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} {#8}Mercenaries{/#8}

provenance.method: Independent whole-unit manual English/Chinese review of Wiki conditions, outcomes and explanations.

units.source: "No one needs to die here. The artifact in exchange for crowns, what say you?"
units.zh: “没必要死人。我出克朗换那件遗物，怎么样？”

provenance.method: Independent whole-unit manual English/Chinese review of Wiki conditions, outcomes and explanations.

units.source: 50% chance: You pay him 40% of your contract reward and get the relic.
units.zh: 50% 概率：你付给他委托报酬的 40%，换回遗物。

provenance.method: Independent whole-unit manual English/Chinese review of Wiki conditions, outcomes and explanations.

units.source: 50% chance: You will fight a {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Brigand Leader{/#4} called 'The Bastard' and a band of {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} {#8}Mercenaries{/#8}

provenance.method: Independent whole-unit manual English/Chinese review of Wiki conditions, outcomes and explanations.

provenance.method: Independent whole-unit manual English/Chinese review of Wiki conditions, outcomes and explanations.

units.source: You lose some reputation, but can finish the contract.
units.zh: 你失去一些声誉，但仍可完成委托。

provenance.method: Independent whole-unit manual English/Chinese review of Wiki conditions, outcomes and explanations.

units.source: "These people have nowhere to go. Just... leave them be."
units.zh: “这些人已经无处可去了。就……别管他们了。”

provenance.method: Independent whole-unit manual English/Chinese review of Wiki conditions, outcomes and explanations.

units.source: Before attacking the brigand camp you notice the famed face of a robber baron. An extra brigand leader will be part of this fight. Your payment will be doubled if you bring his head, but an event with bounty hunters demanding you to give them the head may happen until contract is complete. Giving them the head will lose the double payment and some reputation with the settlement, but NOT fail the contract in this case.
units.zh: 进攻强盗营地之前，你认出了一名臭名昭著的强盗男爵。因此这场战斗会额外出现一名强盗头目。带回他的头颅可以获得双倍报酬，但在委托完成前，可能触发赏金猎人要求你交出头颅的事件。把头颅交给他们会失去双倍报酬，并降低一些与聚落的关系，但这种情况下不会导致委托失败。

provenance.method: Independent whole-unit manual English/Chinese review of Wiki conditions, outcomes and explanations.

units.source: 35% chance: The {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}unholds{/#4} flee (contract completed) and he gets a good mood.

provenance.method: Independent whole-unit manual English/Chinese review of Wiki conditions, outcomes and explanations.

units.zh: 65% 概率：他遭受临时{#1}伤势{/#1}，心情变差，战斗照常开始。

provenance.method: Independent whole-unit manual English/Chinese review of Wiki conditions, outcomes and explanations.

units.source: You are approached by a man that wants to keep the location a secret if you find it. You can choose:
units.zh: 一个男人找上你，希望你找到目标地点后替他保密。你可以选择：

provenance.method: Independent whole-unit manual English/Chinese review of Wiki conditions, outcomes and explanations.

units.source: "I don't think so. Only our employer will learn where it is."
units.zh: “不行。只有雇主会知道它的位置。”

provenance.method: Independent whole-unit manual English/Chinese review of Wiki conditions, outcomes and explanations.

units.source: "We have a deal. You and noone else will learn where it is."
units.zh: “成交。除了你，没人会知道它的位置。”

provenance.method: Independent whole-unit manual English/Chinese review of Wiki conditions, outcomes and explanations.

units.source: You get the bribe money and fail the contract. You lose some settlement relations and a bit of faction relations.
units.zh: 你拿到贿赂，但委托失败，与聚落的关系降低一些，与其所属势力的关系也略有下降。

provenance.method: Independent whole-unit manual English/Chinese review of Wiki conditions, outcomes and explanations.

units.source: "Why get paid only once if we can get paid twice?"
units.zh: “能拿两份钱，何必只拿一份？”

provenance.method: Independent whole-unit manual English/Chinese review of Wiki conditions, outcomes and explanations.

units.source: You get the bribe and contract money. You lose a large amount of settlement relations and some faction relations.
units.zh: 你同时拿到贿赂和委托报酬，但与聚落的关系大幅下降，与其所属势力的关系也有所降低。

units.source: After meeting a shady man your envoy gets attacked by {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Mercenaries{/#4} and you can choose:
units.zh: 遇到一个形迹可疑的人之后，你护送的使者遭到{#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1}{#4}佣兵{/#4}袭击。你可以选择：

provenance.method: Independent whole-unit manual English/Chinese review of Wiki conditions, outcomes and explanations.

units.source: "Why bleed for crowns when you offer them freely? We have a deal."
units.zh: “既然你愿意直接付钱，又何必为钱流血？成交。”

provenance.method: Independent whole-unit manual English/Chinese review of Wiki conditions, outcomes and explanations.

units.source: You get the promised bribe money, fail the contract and get flagged as a {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} betrayer by that noble house.
units.zh: 你拿到承诺的贿赂，委托失败，并被该贵族家族标记为{#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1}背叛者。

provenance.method: Independent whole-unit manual English/Chinese review of Wiki conditions, outcomes and explanations.

units.source: The {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Mercenaries{/#4} attack and you can continue the contract.

provenance.method: Independent whole-unit manual English/Chinese review of Wiki conditions, outcomes and explanations.

units.source: Your men captured some of the defenders. You get to decide their fate. You can choose:
units.zh: 你的弟兄俘虏了几名守军，现在由你决定他们的命运。你可以选择：

provenance.method: Independent whole-unit manual English/Chinese review of Wiki conditions, outcomes and explanations.

units.source: "Let them go. The rival house may take it as a sign of good faith."
units.zh: “放他们走吧，敌对家族也许会把这视为善意。”

provenance.method: Independent whole-unit manual English/Chinese review of Wiki conditions, outcomes and explanations.

units.zh: “他们可能值点钱。把这些俘虏交给指挥官。”

provenance.method: Independent whole-unit manual English/Chinese review of Wiki conditions, outcomes and explanations.

units.source: "Better to kill them now than face them again in battle in the days to come."
units.zh: “与其日后在战场上再遇到，不如现在就杀了他们。”

provenance.method: Independent whole-unit manual English/Chinese review of Wiki conditions, outcomes and explanations.

units.zh: 你失去一些声誉；选择此项有助于更快结束{#1}贵族战争{/#1}。

provenance.method: Independent whole-unit manual English/Chinese review of Wiki conditions, outcomes and explanations.

units.source: After the battle the brigands beg for mercy. You can choose:
units.zh: 战斗结束后，强盗向你求饶。你可以选择：

provenance.method: Independent whole-unit manual English/Chinese review of Wiki conditions, outcomes and explanations.

units.source: Leader of the indebted offers a bargain for their freedom. Accepting the offer will result in the failure of the contract but an undead location will be revealed that will contain a named item.
units.zh: 负债者的领头人提出用情报换取自由。接受交易会导致委托失败，但会在地图上揭示一处藏有名贵装备的亡灵据点。

provenance.method: Independent whole-unit manual English/Chinese review of Wiki conditions, outcomes and explanations.

units.source: Noblehouse units stop your caravan and demand you to surrender the goods. You can choose:
units.zh: 贵族家族的部队拦住商队，要求你交出货物。你可以选择：

provenance.method: Independent whole-unit manual English/Chinese review of Wiki conditions, outcomes and explanations.

units.source: "I don't think so. We'll defend it if need be."
units.zh: “不可能。必要时我们会拔刀保护货物。”

provenance.method: Independent whole-unit manual English/Chinese review of Wiki conditions, outcomes and explanations.

units.source: You will fight noble troops and the house gets hostile. Though you can still finish the contract and will receive twice as much relation with the contracter.
units.zh: 你将与贵族部队战斗，该家族会变为敌对。但你仍可完成委托，并获得通常两倍的雇主关系提升。

units.source: "We aren't paid enough to make enemies of your noblehouse. Take them."
units.zh: “这点报酬不值得我们与你们家族为敌，拿走吧。”

units.zh: “我们战团可是盟友，你家领主不会喜欢你们这样拦路。”仅在与该家族关系良好时可选。

units.source: Your men ask you to take the cargo for yourself. You can choose:
units.zh: 弟兄们提议将货物据为己有。你可以选择：

provenance.method: Independent whole-unit manual English/Chinese review of Wiki conditions, outcomes and explanations.

units.source: "Get back to work before I beat you there. We have a contract to fulfill."
units.zh: “赶紧干活，不然老子用拳头催你们。我们还有委托要完成。”

provenance.method: Independent whole-unit manual English/Chinese review of Wiki conditions, outcomes and explanations.

units.source: "Finally, luck smiles upon us. We take the gems for ourselves!"
units.zh: “运气终于站在我们这边了！宝石归我们了！”

provenance.method: Independent whole-unit manual English/Chinese review of Wiki conditions, outcomes and explanations.

units.source: You lose 200 renown, 100 relation with the settlement (will turn them hostile) and 10 reputation.
units.zh: 你失去 200 声望、100 点与聚落的关系，以及 10 声誉；聚落会因此变为敌对。

provenance.method: Independent whole-unit manual English/Chinese review of Wiki conditions, outcomes and explanations.

units.source: You have to fight but can continue the contract. (you are surrounded)
units.zh: 你必须战斗，但仍可继续执行委托。开战时你处于包围之中。

provenance.method: Independent whole-unit manual English/Chinese review of Wiki conditions, outcomes and explanations.

units.source: The {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}hexe{/#4} will make your {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} superstitious brother become {#8}{#9}{#10/}{/#9}{/#8} afraid (50% less {#11}{#12}{#13/}{/#12}{/#11} for a few days) after the battle. He gets a bad mood too.

provenance.method: Independent whole-unit manual English/Chinese review of Wiki conditions, outcomes and explanations.

units.source: You have to deal with women and children after the battle. You can choose:
units.zh: 战斗结束后，你还得决定如何处置妇女和儿童。你可以选择：

units.source: "We're paid to leave no one alive, so that's what we'll do."
units.zh: “拿钱办事，一个活口也不能留。”

provenance.method: Independent whole-unit manual English/Chinese review of Wiki conditions, outcomes and explanations.

units.source: You loose a large amount of reputation and continue the contract.
units.zh: 你失去大量声誉，继续执行委托。

units.zh: 你获得一定声誉，但委托失败的概率提高 45%。
